facts.text: The user asked about Prince George's County, Maryland in history.
The user asked about pre-European encounters in Prince George's County, Maryland.
The user stated that the area was likely inhabited by various indigenous tribes for thousands of years before European arrival.
The user asked for a child or children to describe the area prior to European settlement.
The user requested a historical first-person POV that is engaging, energetic, and action-oriented rather than passive, in diary style.
The user asked what children would see if they looked in a river and caught their reflections.
The user introduced a character named Little Deer and asked for little deer and his friends (boys and girls) to look in the river.
The user asked what nature looked like then to Little Deer and his friends.
